title: Rising health inequities require looking beyond health systems
title_zh: 健康不平等上升，视野需超越卫生系统
abstract: Global health inequity is increasingly driven by the triple planetary crisis of climate change, biodiversity loss and pollution. To address it, we must place health at the centre of climate and environmental action and develop interventions that target both individual behaviours and structural drivers of inequality.
abstract_zh: 全球健康不平等日益受到气候变化、生物多样性丧失和污染这三重星球危机的驱动。必须将健康置于气候和环境行动的中心，并开发针对个人行为和不平等结构性驱动因素的干预措施。
